title: Gotrade Daily: PayPal Reports as Memory Rebounds
summary: Wall Street is in wait-and-see mode into the Fed. PayPal and Visa report tonight and memory stocks rebound. Tonight's watchlist: PYPL, NVDA, MU, V.
body_markdown:
At the same time, memory stocks that came under pressure last week are rebounding. Fears of a supply glut have eased, and sentiment across the tech sector is improving into the mega-cap prints.


## Tonight's Watchlist 📈


Stock Movement What to Watch


[PYPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pypl/) Reports before the open Q2 earnings, est. EPS around $1.28; margin direction and payment volume


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Roughly flat pre-market AI bellwether ahead of Microsoft and Meta earnings on Wednesday


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) Higher (~+2.5%) pre-market Memory supply-glut fears easing; HBM demand stays strong


[V](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/v/) Reports after the close Fiscal Q3, est. EPS around $3.22; a gauge of consumer-spending health


## Tonight's Catalysts 🧨


### A Payments Earnings Night


**PayPal ([PYPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pypl/) )** reports before the open with est. EPS around $1.28 on revenue near $8.48B. Non-GAAP earnings are seen falling about 9% year over year, so margin direction and payment volume are the keys. **Visa ([V](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/v/) )** follows after the close with est. EPS around $3.22 on revenue near $11.35B. Its results are a measure of how well consumer spending is holding up.


### Memory Stocks Rebound


After coming under pressure last week, memory stocks are turning higher. **Micron ([MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) )** rose pre-market as supply-glut fears eased and demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) stayed strong. **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** traded roughly flat and remains the AI bellwether, especially ahead of Microsoft and Meta on Wednesday.
